subject: OvmfPkg: SEC/SMM: Use 256 IDT Descriptors
reasons: Part of a series (with 3454d7ab41, 4512733ac8) replacing local magic-number IDT entry count constants (SEC_IDT_ENTRY_COUNT=34, 32) with the centrally defined X86_CPU_INTERRUPT_NUM macro across multiple packages
Pattern is well-defined: replace integer literal (32, 34) or local #define with X86_CPU_INTERRUPT_NUM in IDT table size expressions and loop bounds
As one-of-N in a series the repetitiveness is high; the same structural substitution is applied in OvmfPkg mirroring the UefiCpuPkg change
candidate_pattern: Replace local IDT entry count constants (32, 34, SEC_IDT_ENTRY_COUNT) with X86_CPU_INTERRUPT_NUM in sizeof() and loop-bound expressions
